description: Herbal-Drug Interaction (HDI) and Indonesian Jamu dietary supplement interaction catalog.
sources: KNApSAcK Database (Indonesian Jamu and Natural Product Metabolomics)
Supp.AI (Allen Institute for AI - Dietary Supplements & Drug Interactions)
Natural Medicines Comprehensive Database / Stockley's Herbal Medicines

kunyit.mechanism: Moderate CYP3A4 inhibition, P-gp transport inhibition, weak antiplatelet activity
kunyit.clinical_risk: Elevated systemic concentration of CYP3A4 substrates; additive bleeding risk with anticoagulants/NSAIDs

sambiloto.mechanism: Platelet aggregation inhibition via thromboxane pathway, mild CYP2C9 modulation
sambiloto.clinical_risk: Synergistic bleeding risk when taken with Warfarin, Aspirin, or Clopidogrel; additive hypotensive risk

grapefruit.mechanism: Mechanism-based irreversible suicide inhibition of intestinal epithelial CYP3A4 and P-gp
grapefruit.clinical_risk: Massive 3x-5x elevation of oral drug bioavailability for Simvastatin, Amlodipine, Tacrolimus

st_johns_wort.mechanism: Potent pregnane X receptor (PXR) activation causing massive CYP3A4, CYP2C9, and P-gp induction
st_johns_wort.clinical_risk: Therapeutic failure and graft rejection with Cyclosporine/Tacrolimus, unplanned pregnancy, subtherapeutic INR

jahe.mechanism: Mild inhibition of thromboxane synthetase and platelet aggregation
jahe.clinical_risk: Minor additive bleeding tendency at high medicinal doses (>4g/day) with Warfarin/Aspirin
